verified: The MATCH Act is a pending US export-control measure that, as LithoWar describes it, would bar sales of immersion DUV lithography scanners to China and cut off parts, service and software support for machines already installed there; explainx and bits-chips.com describe the bill the same way, with explainx reporting it is currently folded into the Senate's defense bill and could be attached to the FY2027 defense legislation in mid-December 2026. LithoWar attributes the figure of roughly 350 immersion scanners in China to ASML's installed base there, and bits-chips.com likewise reports the bill would cut support for "much of the installed fleet."
unconfirmed: The ~350 figure is an estimate that none of the available reports traces to an ASML disclosure or a regulatory document, and LithoWar's central claim — that a servicing ban would let rivals take over maintenance, reverse-engineer the tools and hire ASML's Chinese staff — is the author's argument about unintended consequences, not a measured outcome. Whether the measure passes, and in what final form, remains open; the reports also note Dutch government opposition and ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet's warning that a total cutoff could backfire, but the source material available here is a headline and teaser, so the underlying sourcing for those positions could not be checked.

verified: LithoWar 发布分析（经 Techmeme 收录）主张，若 MATCH Act 禁止 ASML 为中国境内约 350 台浸没式 DUV 光刻机提供零部件、维保与软件支持，结果可能适得其反，让竞争对手获得承接维保、逆向工程这些设备以及招募 ASML 人员的机会。这是该文的论点，而非已经发生的事实；bits-chips.com 也刊出同向评论，称该法案将禁售所有浸没式光刻机并切断相当一部分已装机队的支持。
unconfirmed: 法案的立法状态说法不一——有汇总称其已写入参议院国防法案，另有报道称可能在 2026 年 12 月中旬被附加到 2027 财年国防授权法案，本条目未能核实哪种说法准确；“约 350 台”是 LithoWar 的估算，无官方数字佐证；竞争对手接手维保、逆向工程与人才流失均属推演，无实证。据 explainx.ai 汇总，荷兰政府正游说反对，ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet 警告全面断供可能反噬，这些说法源自《亚洲时报》11 月 27 日报道，本条未提供原文佐证。

titles.en: MATCH Act's ASML China service ban could backfire, LithoWar analysis argues
